item.title: Population
item.description:
Source: TW

About 63% of the growth in human population from 1915 to the present can be attributed to the Haber-Bosch process +++(which synthesizes ammonia for nitrogen fertilizers)+++. If not, we would have far fewer people on earth and still be fighting ferocious wars over access to bird shit.
